full_original_object.facet: Emergency-save backup message request versus actual old backup state
full_original_object.source_fact: After successful Game.save the emergency path requests both saved and previous-file-backed-up messages regardless of whether an old file existed; actual backup copy is conditioned on old-file existence.
full_original_object.counterevidence: UI65 section4.2 already specifies the unconditional two-message success path and conditioned copy. WP10/MG07's statement that a previous file is actually backed up only when one existed is true as a state fact. Its wording does not itself conclusively assert absence of the message request. Preserve this distinction; do not create a required root merely by reading the state-truth qualification as a UI predicate.
